title: Words to read and colour: Joined reading fluency check in pairs
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 38. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Joined reading fluency check in pairs). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا (٣)

head: Not this
This
rows: Point to the letter, say its sound, let your partner try

questions.q: Read the line «فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ» together.
Pairs: read the Qaidah line on the pupil PDF to your partner, then swap. The teacher listens in each room and ticks the fluency check.
questions.a: Each child reads the line; teacher ticks fluent or developing.

questions.q: Extend: read the line faster with no mistakes.
If your partner gets stuck, you ...
options: point to the first letter and help kindly
questions.a: A) point to the first letter and help kindly. We help kindly and let them try.

questions.q: Think again: How can you help a friend who gets stuck on a word, without saying it for them straight away?
questions.a: Point to the first letter, say its sound, let them try; then say 'well done'.
